audit.sql: SELECT a.category, a.completion_rate, b.engagement_rate FROM (SELECT cd.category AS category, AVG(completion_rate) AS completion_rate FROM play_detail pd JOIN content_dim cd ON pd.content_id = cd.content_id WHERE pd.created_at BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY cd.category) a JOIN (SELECT cd.category AS category, (SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'comment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'play' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS engagement_rate FROM user_behavior_fact ubf JOIN content_dim cd ON ubf.content_id = cd.content_id WHERE ubf.timestamp BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY cd.category) b ON a.category = b.category
